jobs.title: Praktikum im Bereich Prädiktive Regelung von Heim-Energiemanagementsystemen
jobs.description:
Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.

Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf deine Bewerbung!

Bist du bereit für die smarte Energiezukunft? Heim-Energiemanagementsysteme (HEMS) gestalten den Energiebedarf im Gebäude flexibler – durch die intelligente Kopplung von Komponenten wie Wärmepumpen, thermischen und elektrischen Speichern, Haushaltsgeräten sowie Elektrofahrzeugen. Mithilfe prädiktiver Regelungsalgorithmen (z. B. MPC) und datenbasierter Prognosen werden lokale Erzeugung, dynamische Stromtarife, Speicherflexibilitäten und Komfortanforderungen simultan optimiert.

- Du erweiterst bestehende Regelungsalgorithmen und entwickelst simulationsbasierte Systemmodelle kontinuierlich weiter, um die Effizienz unserer Energiesysteme zu steigern.

- Praxistaugliche und echtzeitfähige Algorithmen zur prädiktiven Regelung von Heim-Energiemanagementsystemen implementierst du eigenverantwortlich und bringst sie zur Anwendungsreife.

- Die Performance der entwickelten Algorithmen bewertest du umfassend im Rahmen verschiedener Simulationsstudien und leitest daraus gezielt Optimierungspotenziale ab.

- Eigenständig führst du Literaturrecherchen durch, um den aktuellen Stand der Technik im Bereich prädiktiver Regelungs-, Modellierungs- und Optimierungsverfahren für HEMS zu erfassen und in unsere Entwicklung einzubringen.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Ausbildung: Masterstudium im Bereich Maschienenbau, Kybernetik, Energietechnik, Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbar mit guten Studienleistungen

- Erfahrungen und Know-how: Programmierkenntnisse in Python, Kenntnisse in modellprädiktiver Regelung, idealerweise Erfahrungen mit Matlab/Simulink

- Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: du bringst proaktiv eigene Ideen ein und bereicherst unser Team durch eine offene und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit

- Arbeitsalltag: wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten

- Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Englisch und sehr gutes Deutsch

jobs.title: Student Smart Career 2026 - 2028
jobs.description:
Discover Bosch in Blaj

Bosch, a true force for innovation and excellence, stands out as a giant of turning vision into reality. The Bosch location in Blaj has been operating since 2007, being the first production unit opened by the Bosch Group in Romania. The road to excellence was initiated in Blaj in the industrial technology sector, later consolidating in the production of sensors and electronic components for the automotive sector.

Starting 2025, the Bosch operations in Blaj are structured under two distinct legal entities: Bosch Automotive SRL and Bosch Rexroth SRL, each specializing in different technological domains.

Bosch Automotive SRL focuses on the production of sensors and transmission control components for the automotive industry, reinforcing Bosch’s commitment to smart, diversified, and sustainable powertrain solutions. The Blaj plant, active in the automotive sector since 2013, plays a vital role in developing cutting-edge technologies that support the mobility of the future. Through continuous investment in innovation and quality, Bosch Automotive in Blaj strengthens its position as a key supplier in the global automotive market.

Since 2007 Bosch Rexroth SRL specializes in industrial technology, focusing on linear motion systems and hydraulic components. The Rexroth entity in Blaj also operates a sales division, providing customized solutions and expert support to industrial customers. The ongoing investment in development and performance reinforces Bosch Rexroth’s role as a vital partner in the global industrial sector.

With a strong focus on innovation, efficiency, and sustainability, Bosch in Blaj continues to grow, offering employees professional development opportunities and fostering a collaborative and inspiring work environment. Whether in automotive technology or industrial technology and automation, Bosch in Blaj remains a pillar of excellence, shaping the future of mobility and industry.

#WorkLikeABosch!

Launched in 2021, Student Smart Career program is created to support the best young talents from our partner universities, to continue their studies, but also to gather experience in an international working environment.

Students will receive a private scholarship provided by the company during the academic year, while during summer they will join the company as working student. After finishing the second year of the program (2026-2027), they have the possibility to receive a Working Student or a full-time position in Bosch Blaj.

- Willingness to develop

- Availability for participation in the program during 2026-2028

- No previous or on-going work relation with Bosch Blaj

jobs.title: Internship in Solid Oxide Cell Development
jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference.

The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application!

A key challenge on the path to climate neutrality is storing power generated by renewable sources, for example in the form of hydrogen. Operating the solid oxide cell (SOC) in electrolysis mode as a solid oxide electrolysis cell (SOEC) enables the direct conversion of electrical energy into chemical energy. Due to its operating temperature of 600 °C and above, the SOEC has the highest electrical efficiency among electrolysis technologies, making it a very promising technology for the hydrogen economy of the future. To improve our understanding of processes occurring during SOEC operation, the cells are experimentally characterized to determine their performance and to provide data for parameterizing or validating physical models that predict cell performance or aging.

- During your internship, you will experimentally characterize SOEC single cells using electrochemical techniques, such as electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and current-voltage characteristics.

- You will support the commissioning of a new test bench, encompassing its initial operation, from software to hardware components, including high-precision measurement devices.

- Last but not least, you will evaluate experimental data and present the results to an interdisciplinary team.

jobs.description:
🏢 About Bosch Group

The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 418,000 associates worldwide. The company generated sales of 90.3 billion euros in 2024. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. At 136 locations across the globe, Bosch employs some 87,000 associates in research and development.

🏢 About Robert Bosch (South East Asia)

As the Bosch Group's regional headquarters in Singapore for Southeast Asia, Robert Bosch (South East Asia) Pte Ltd has represented the Group's interests across the region since 1923. With diversified businesses in Mobility Aftermarket, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Building Technology. Robert Bosch (SEA) Pte Ltd includes the Asia Pacific headquarters for Mobility Aftermarket, Building Technology, and Industrial Technology, as well as the Southeast Asia R&D setup for Corporate Research, Advance Engineering Centre, and Bosch Business Innovations, Bosch's in-house innovation and startup incubation network. At Bosch, we are committed through our EVP ensuring all our associates to GROW, ENJOY and INSPIRE during their journey with us.

💼 Role Overview

Are you passionate about storytelling, creativity, and connecting people with meaningful career opportunities? Join Bosch Singapore as an Employer Branding Intern and help bring our employer brand to life!

As part of the Human Resources team, you will contribute to initiatives that strengthen Bosch's position as an employer of choice, enhance talent attraction, and create meaningful engagement with students, graduates, and professionals.

You will gain hands-on experience in employer branding, digital communications, talent attraction, campus engagement, and project coordination within a global technology organization. Working closely with HR colleagues and cross-functional stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to turn creative ideas into impactful campaigns, showcase the Bosch employee experience, and contribute to initiatives that support our talent pipeline and future workforce.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

Employer Branding & Content Creation

- Support the planning and execution of employer branding initiatives and campaigns across digital platforms, in alignment with Bosch's established strategy and direction.

- Create engaging content and recruitment marketing materials, including social media posts, employee stories, recruitment videos, and other branding collaterals to showcase Bosch's culture and career opportunities.

- Stay updated on social media and employer branding trends, conducting research and proposing creative ideas to enhance ongoing initiatives.

Digital Communications & Campaign Analytics

- Monitor campaign performance, compile relevant metrics, and provide insights to evaluate effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.

- Maintain employer branding resources, content calendars, and marketing collaterals to ensure accuracy and brand consistency.

Campus Engagement & Talent Attraction

- Support the planning and execution of campus engagement initiatives, career fairs, and recruitment events to strengthen Bosch's presence among students and graduates.

- Assist in developing engaging activities and materials to showcase Bosch's culture and career opportunities, while supporting initiatives that strengthen the talent pipeline, including internship programs, graduate opportunities, and university partnerships.

- Coordinate event logistics, outreach materials, and stakeholder communications to ensure smooth execution.

- Support additional projects and ad-hoc tasks as assigned.

We welcome applications from students who are passionate about employer branding, communications, marketing, and human resources.

Education & Background

- Currently pursuing a degree in Human Resources, Business, Marketing, Communications, Media, or related fields.

Experience & Expertise

- Prior experience in content creation, social media management, video editing, event coordination, or relevant school projects would be an added advantage.

- Familiar with social media platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook, with demonstrated interest in current content and digital marketing trends.

- Comfortable using content creation tools such as Canva, CapCut, or similar platforms for graphic design and video editing.

Core Competencies & Skills

- Creative and curious, with a strong interest in employer branding, talent attraction, storytelling, and digital communications.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels.

- Organized and able to manage multiple tasks, coordinate timelines, and follow through on project deliverables.

- Able to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a collaborative team.

jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan technologie die mensen helpt veilig te blijven!

📍 Berkel en Rodenrijs 🕒 Fulltime | Dagdienst

Hoe worden losse technische onderdelen uiteindelijk een betrouwbaar ontruimingssysteem? Dat ontdek je hier van dichtbij. Sterker nog: je bouwt het zelf.

Als Assembly Medewerker bij 4EVAC (Hacousto Holland BV / Bosch) assembleer, test en controleer je onze producten. Dat doe je samen met je collega's in een klein team. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat ieder product zorgvuldig wordt gemaakt en goed werkt voordat het naar de klant gaat.

Het mooie aan dit werk? Je ziet wat je maakt én je weet waarvoor je het maakt: bijdragen aan de veiligheid van mensen en gebouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

- Ontruimingsmaterialen en bijbehorende onderdelen samenstellen en monteren.

- Producten testen en controleren of alles goed werkt.

- Kwaliteitscontroles uitvoeren tijdens het productieproces.

- Orders inpakken en verzendklaar maken.

- Werken volgens onze kwaliteits- en werkprocedures.

- Samenwerken met je collega's om het productieproces soepel te laten verlopen.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Wat ga je doen?

Ontruimingsmaterialen en bijbehorende onderdelen samenstellen en monteren.

- Producten testen en controleren of alles goed werkt.

- Kwaliteitscontroles uitvoeren tijdens het productieproces.

- Orders inpakken en verzendklaar maken.

- Werken volgens onze kwaliteits- en werkprocedures.

- Samenwerken met je collega's om het productieproces soepel te laten verlopen.

Wie zoeken wij?

Je hoeft geen ervaren assemblagespecialist te zijn.

We zoeken vooral iemand die graag met de handen werkt, technisch inzicht heeft en voldoening haalt uit werk dat netjes en zorgvuldig is uitgevoerd.

Heb je al ervaring met assemblage of fijnmontage? Mooi meegenomen. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je handig en wil je het vak graag leren? Dan komen we ook graag met je in contact.

Jij brengt mee:

- MBO werk- en denkniveau is een pré.

- Je bent handig en hebt technisch inzicht.

- Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor kwaliteit.

- Je kunt werkinstructies in ieder geval in het Engels lezen en begrijpen.

- Je bent leergierig en vindt het prettig om samen te werken met collega's.

- Je bent beschikbaar voor een fulltimebaan.

Bonuspunten als je:

- Ervaring hebt met assemblage, productie of fijnmontage.

- Nederlands begrijpt en/of spreekt.

Jouw ontwikkeling:

Je hoeft niet vanaf dag één alles te kunnen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je technisch gevoel hebt, zorgvuldig werkt en openstaat om nieuwe dingen te leren. Tijdens je werk leer je onze producten steeds beter kennen. Je ontdekt hoe de verschillende onderdelen in elkaar zitten, hoe je producten controleert en test en waar je tijdens de assemblage op moet letten. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf stap voor stap verder binnen een technische productieomgeving.

Waarom 4EVAC?

Bij 4EVAC (Hacousto Holland BV / Bosch) in Berkel en Rodenrijs ontwerpen en produceren we geavanceerde gesproken ontruimingsoplossingen voor uiteenlopende toepassingen, van kleine tot grootschalige projecten.

Onze klanten bevinden zich over de hele wereld.

Voor jou betekent dit vooral dat je werkt aan een tastbaar technisch product met een duidelijk doel: bijdragen aan veilige gebouwen. Je komt terecht in een klein en gedreven team, waarin samenwerken belangrijk is en waar ruimte is om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

jobs.title: Industrialization Project Manager_VM
jobs.description:
Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

Job Summary:

Industrialization project leader is responsible for taking a new product from prototype to mass production. Act as the critical bridge between the Research & Development (R&D)/Engineering teams and the Manufacturing/Operations teams. The primary goal is to ensure that a product can be manufactured reliably, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

Job Responsibilities:

- Project Planning and Management

- Develop Master Plan: Create, own, and manage the comprehensive industrialization project plan, including timelines, milestones, deliverables, and critical path analysis.

- Risk Management: Proactively identify potential risks to the project (technical, supply chain, quality, budget) and develop mitigation strategies.

- Resource Allocation: Coordinate with department heads to secure the necessary resources, including personnel, equipment, and facility space.

- Reporting and Communication: Provide regular status updates, reports, and presentations to key stakeholders, including senior management, on project progress, risks, and budget.

- Technical and Process Leadership

- Design for Manufacturability (DFM/DFA): Collaborate with the design engineering team early in the development cycle to ensure the product design is optimized for efficient manufacturing and assembly.

- Process Definition: Define, develop, and document the entire manufacturing process, from raw material intake to final product packaging.

- Tooling and Equipment: Lead the specification, procurement, installation, and qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) of all necessary manufacturing equipment, jigs, fixtures, and tooling.

- Pilot and Pre-production Runs: Plan and manage pilot production runs to test the manufacturing process, identify issues, and validate equipment and procedures before full-scale launch.

- Production Ramp-Up: Oversee the gradual increase in production volume (ramp-up), monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) like yield, cycle time, and quality.

- Documentation: Ensure all manufacturing documentation, such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and process control plans, are created, validated, and released.

- Cross-Functional Team Coordination

- Central Point of Contact: Act as the primary liaison between all involved departments, including R&D, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Production, and Marketing.

- Facilitate Collaboration: Lead cross-functional team meetings to drive decisions, resolve conflicts, and ensure alignment on project goals.

- Manage Stakeholder Expectations: Clearly communicate project objectives and constraints to all stakeholders to ensure a shared understanding and manage expectations.

- Quality and Compliance

- Quality Standards: Work with the Quality Assurance team to define quality criteria, inspection methods, and control plans for the product and process.

- Validation and Qualification: Ensure that the manufacturing process is fully validated to consistently produce products that meet specifications.

- Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the manufacturing process and facility comply with all relevant industry standards and government regulations (e.g., ISO, FDA, CE).

- Root Cause Analysis: Lead problem-solving efforts for any failures or deviations encountered during pilot runs and production ramp-up.

- Supply Chain and Procurement

- Supplier Qualification: Collaborate with the procurement team to identify, evaluate, and qualify suppliers for critical components and raw materials.

- Material Readiness: Ensure a stable and qualified supply chain is in place to support production launch and ramp-up.

- Bill of Materials (BOM) Management: Oversee the transition of the Engineering BOM (eBOM) to a Manufacturing BOM (mBOM), ensuring accuracy and completeness.

- Financial and Budget Management

- Budget Development: Develop and manage the project budget, including Capital Expenditures (CapEx) for equipment and Operational Expenditures (OpEx) for materials and labor.

- Cost Tracking: Monitor project spending against the budget and report on any variances.

- Cost Optimization: Continuously look for opportunities to reduce manufacturing costs without compromising quality

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

🎁Q4 JOINING BONUS

Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Penetration Tester to join our AI Safety & Security team, working hands-on across Bosch's growing portfolio of AI-enabled products and internal tooling — LLM deployments, agentic AI systems, and Model Context Protocol – style tool-calling integrations. Under the direction of the team's Lead AI Safety & Security Engineer, you will execute structured test plans against real systems, covering both whether an AI system behaves safely (does it refuse harmful requests, stay within its intended scope) and whether it is secure (can it be manipulated via prompt injection or tricked into misusing its tools). This is an individual-contributor role on a newly forming team — you'll be running real engagements from day one, not just shadowing them.

Key Responsibilities

- Execute penetration tests and safety evaluations against LLM-based features and AI agents, following test plans and specifications defined by the team lead.

- Run red-teaming and jailbreak testing to surface harmful, biased, or unsafe model outputs, and document reproducible findings.

- Test for prompt injection (direct and indirect), excessive agency, and tool/plugin abuse in agentic and MCP-style tool-calling systems.

- Verify human-in-the-loop and guardrail controls hold up under adversarial conditions, not just in normal use.

- Write clear, reproducible findings reports — evidence, severity, and a specific recommended fix — that both engineers and governance stakeholders can act on.

- Help build and maintain test tooling: adversarial-prompt scripts, jailbreak test cases, and MCP/tool-schema fuzzing scripts.

- Track published AI security research (OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10s, MITRE ATLAS) and bring new attack techniques into the team's test suite.

- Work directly with AI/ML engineering teams to reproduce, triage, and confirm fixes for reported findings.

- Support the team lead in scoping and coordinating external red-teaming/pentest vendor engagements when work is outsourced.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

- 2–5 years in penetration testing, security testing, or applied AI/ML security work.

- Hands-on experience testing LLM or agentic AI systems — prompt injection, jailbreaks, or tool/plugin abuse; coursework, CTFs, or independent projects count given how new this field is.

- Working familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and/or OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications.

- Comfortable scripting in Python and/or JavaScript/Node to automate test cases.

- Clear, precise technical writing for findings reports.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks.

- Traditional penetration testing experience across web, API, or network targets.

- Familiarity with AI governance concepts (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).

- Open-source security tooling contributions, CTF results, or a public research/write-up portfolio.

Relevant Certifications (any of the following a plus)

- Offensive security / penetration testing — OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CEH.

- AI-specific security — ISC2 AI Security Certificate or Certified AI Security Professional (CAISP).

The Bosch Home Comfort Group is looking forward to your application!

We are looking for a motivated intern to help us continue developing our machine-learning solutions for heat pump reliability. jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

🎁Q4 JOINING BONUS

Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Key Account Engineer to support automotive component projects for Japanese OEM customers across Passenger Car (PC) and Commercial Vehicle (CV) applications.

In this role, you will act as a key technical interface between customers and Bosch engineering teams, supporting projects from acquisition and technical clarification through project execution and engineering changes.

A key opportunity of this position is a long-term onsite assignment at Bosch Japan for at least 2.5 years, expected to start by March 2027 or earlier. The assignment comes with an attractive benefits package, and family accompaniment to Japan can be supported.

You will also have the opportunity to build specialized technical expertise in DNOX and exhaust aftertreatment systems while collaborating with Bosch platform and engineering teams in Europe.

What You’ll Do

- Act as the first-level Technical Key Account (TKA) for assigned automotive component projects.

- Serve as the main technical interface with Japanese OEM customers, handling technical questions, requirements, and clarifications.

- Support the execution of customer projects for Passenger Car and Commercial Vehicle applications, ensuring alignment with project requirements and milestones.

- Support new project acquisition activities for Japanese OEM customers, particularly technical documentation and project-related inputs.

- Coordinate and track Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) for Passenger Car customer projects.

- Take ownership of relevant Quality Gate (QG) activities and support timely achievement of project milestones.

- Investigate and support continuous improvement activities related to component and field quality issues.

- Prepare, maintain, and coordinate technical customer documentation according to project and customer requirements.

- Support engineering activities such as technical drawings, experiments, and validation when required.

- Develop strong technical expertise in DNOX products and systems through close collaboration with Bosch platform teams in Europe, particularly Hungary.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

- Approximately 4–6 years of relevant engineering experience, preferably in automotive, mechanical/product engineering, component development, or a related technical environment.

- Strong Japanese communication skills for direct interaction with Japanese customers; JLPT N2 or equivalent business-level Japanese proficiency is preferred.

- Good English communication skills for collaboration with international engineering teams and overseas stakeholders.

- Basic knowledge of mechanical design, product engineering, automotive components, or product development.

- Strong problem-solving skills with a customer-oriented mindset.

- Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across different cultures, functions, and locations.

- Proactive learning mindset and willingness to develop specialized technical and product knowledge.

- Willingness to undertake a long-term onsite assignment at Bosch Japan for at least 2.5 years, starting by March 2027 or earlier.

It'd be a strong advantage if you have:

- Knowledge or experience in DNOX, exhaust aftertreatment systems, or emission-control technologies.

- Previous experience working with Japanese automotive OEMs.

- Experience in project coordination, customer-facing engineering, or Technical Key Account (TKA) responsibilities.

- Experience working in an international or cross-functional engineering environment.

As a Data Scientist, you will help shape the future of manufacturing by transforming complex engineering and production challenges into data-driven solutions that create measurable business value.

Working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Industrial Analytics, you will analyse manufacturing data to uncover patterns, identify root causes and drive process improvements. Your insights will support smarter decisions, enhance product quality and increase operational efficiency across manufacturing environments.

You will develop and validate AI/ML models and advanced analytics solutions for use cases such as:

- Quality improvement and process optimization

- Anomaly detection and root cause analysis

- Predictive maintenance and failure prediction

- Productivity and yield improvement

- Process stability monitoring

- Decision support for engineering and manufacturing teams

As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate closely with Process Experts, Technology Development Engineers, Data Analysts, MES/PLC specialists, Data Engineers, MLOps teams, IT professionals and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are scalable, explainable and aligned with real operational needs.

You will contribute throughout the entire solution lifecycle, from problem definition and data exploration to model development, validation, deployment support and continuous improvement. In addition, you will help standardize and reuse analytical methods, models and best practices across projects and locations, supporting Bosch's digital transformation journey and Industry 4.0 initiatives.

- Experience developing Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or Advanced Analytics solutions.

- Hands-on experience working with complex datasets in industrial, engineering, manufacturing or technical environments.

- Experience contributing to end-to-end data science projects, including data preparation, model development, validation and deployment.

- Exposure to manufacturing, process development, industrialization, quality improvement or equipment-related analytics is considered an advantage.

Know-how

1. Machine Learning & Advanced Analytics

- Knowledge of machine learning methods, including regression, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, forecasting and optimization.

jobs.title: PhD - Predictive Occupancy World Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference.

The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application!

The Corporate Research division is the heart of our innovation. You will be part of the Bosch Research Computer Vision and AI Lab in Hildesheim, Germany, at the forefront of developing the next generation of autonomous systems. We are looking for a passionate and creative PhD candidate to join our team and help shape the future of AI-driven mobility.

- You will develop a generic predictive occupancy model as the core representation of the driving scene, designing architectures that capture the geometry and semantics of all objects to enable an explicit understanding of 4D world dynamics.

- Furthermore, you will research, implement, and evaluate novel end-to-end (E2E) driving architectures based on predictive occupancy world models, ensuring robust situational awareness and safe navigation.

- You will develop state-of-the-art perception systems that seamlessly transform raw sensor data into rich spatial representations and driving actions, bridging the gap between perception and automated driving.

- As part of this role, you will create architectures in which driving decisions are directly based on predictive occupancy world models, ensuring spatially grounded and reliable actions.

- Last but not least, you will rigorously test your models in simulation and with real-world data, demonstrating improvements in safety, transparency, and performance, and you will publish your findings at leading AI and robotics conferences.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Education: excellent master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field that qualifies you for doctoral studies

- Experience and Knowledge: strong expertise in Deep Learning and Computer Vision (CV), hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch), and proven Python programming skills; experience in 3D Computer Vision, Occupancy Networks, End-to-End (E2E) Driving, World Models, or Sensor Fusion is highly desirable; familiarity with autonomous driving datasets and simulation environments (e.g., CARLA) is considered an advantage

- Personality and Working Practice: you are a creative and self-driven researcher who enjoys taking ownership of challenging topics, developing innovative ideas comes naturally to you, and you thrive both independently and in technical discussions with colleagues

- Enthusiasm: you have a genuine passion for solving fundamental AI challenges and are driven to build systems that are not only intelligent but also trustworthy and safe

- Languages: excellent English skills, German is an advantage

jobs.title: [EJV] Senior Telematics Software Engineer (with Joining Bonus)
jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

🎁Q4 JOINING BONUS

Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Telematics Software Engineer to design, develop, and deliver connected-vehicle software across two vehicle domains: Commercial Vehicle / Off-Highway (trucks, buses, construction, and agricultural machinery) and Passenger Car. You will own features end-to-end on the Telematics Control Unit (TCU) — from vehicle-network data acquisition through edge processing to cloud connectivity — and adapt platform software to the distinct protocols, duty cycles, and regulatory requirements of each segment.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and maintain embedded telematics software on TCU platforms (Embedded Linux / RTOS) for both CV/OHW and Passenger Car programs.

- Develop vehicle-network interfaces: CAN / CAN-FD, J1939 and FMS (CV), ISOBUS / ISO 11783 (OHW), and OEM-specific signal matrices, UDS (ISO 14229) and DoIP diagnostics (Passenger Car).

- Implement connectivity and cloud communication: 4G/5G modem integration, GNSS, MQTT/HTTPS telemetry pipelines, and device management with AWS IoT / Azure IoT or equivalent.

- Build and maintain OTA (FOTA/SOTA) update mechanisms, remote diagnostics, and fleet-management data services.

- Implement regulatory and safety-related features: eCall / ERA-GLONASS, tachograph and driver-data interfaces (CV), and emissions/usage monitoring data reporting.

- Apply automotive cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156) and support functional safety activities (ISO 26262) where applicable.

- Own features end-to-end: requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, unit/integration testing, vehicle-level validation, and issue resolution in the field.

- Collaborate with OEM customers, cloud/backend teams, hardware engineers, and suppliers; support SOP milestones and field escalations.

- Mentor junior engineers and drive code quality through reviews, CI/CD, and static analysis.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or related field.

- 5–8 years of embedded software development in automotive, telematics, or IoT, with strong C/C++ (C++14 or later); Python for tooling and test automation.

- Proficiency with automotive tooling: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, bus analyzers, debuggers (JTAG/Lauterbach), Git, CI/CD.

- Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto/Buildroot) and/or RTOS on ARM-based platforms.

- Experience with cellular connectivity (LTE/5G modems, AT command / RIL integration), GNSS, and cloud protocols (MQTT, TLS, REST).

- Experience with OTA update frameworks and secure boot / secure communication concepts.

- Strong debugging skills across embedded, network, and cloud boundaries; able to work directly with vehicles and test benches.

- Solid knowledge of vehicle networks and protocols: CAN / CAN-FD, J1939, UDS, DoIP; experience with at least one of ISOBUS, FMS, or Automotive Ethernet / SOME-IP.

- Familiarity with Automotive SPICE or comparable structured development processes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience delivering telematics features in both commercial vehicle/off-highway and passenger car programs.

- Experience working with global OEM customers and multi-site development teams.

- Experience with eCall / ERA-GLONASS, digital tachograph (EU 165/2014), or emissions telematics (e.g., OBD-over-telematics, China GB17691).

- AUTOSAR Classic or Adaptive experience; Android Automotive or QNX exposure.

- Knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 (cybersecurity) and ISO 26262 (functional safety).

- V2X (DSRC / C-V2X), edge analytics, or vehicle data platforms (e.g., COVESA VSS).

https://www.bosch.fr/carrieres/pourquoi-bosch/

Bosch Home Comfort Group est l'un des principaux fabricants européens de solutions éco-performantes de chauffage, de production d’eau chaude, de rafraîchissement domestiques et industrielles durables et économes en énergie. L'entreprise a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 4,5 milliards d’euros en 2022 et emploie 14 400 personnes. Bosch Home Comfort Group possède de fortes marques internationales et régionales, et fabrique une gamme de produits diversifiée en Europe, en Amérique et en Asie.

En France, Bosch Home Comfort Group comprend les marques Bosch et elm.leblanc et fabrique dans ses deux usines de Drancy (93) et Saint-Thégonnec (29). L’entreprise emploie 900 collaborateurs sur tout le territoire.

Plaçant toujours l’utilisateur au coeur de sa démarche, l’entreprise conçoit et fabrique une gamme de produits toujours plus innovants et des solutions conçues pour optimiser le confort du bâti et le rendre toujours plus agréable.

Notre ambition est de muscler notre présence sur le marché de l’électrification avec le déploiement des pompes à chaleur air/eau, air/air et hybrides.

www.bosch-homecomfort.fr ; www.elmleblanc.fr

Rattaché au Responsable Supply Chain, vous serez en charge des missions suivantes :

- Gestion de la relation avec nos fournisseurs internes et externes

- Commandes de cadencement auprès des fournisseurs tout en assurant un lissage des approvisionnements et en prenant en compte la prévision des ventes

- Mettre à jour et maintenir la base de données IT des produits finis et vérifier les EDI fournisseurs.

A ces missions, s'ajoutent la participation aux projets d'amélioration continue du service.

jobs.description:
At Bosch Mobility Aftermarket, we believe in creating a work culture that embodies our core values of grow, enjoy, and inspire. Our Mobility Aftermarket division provides diagnostic and repair shop equipment, spare parts, and repair solutions for passenger cars and commercial vehicles worldwide. Our Automotive Service Solutions operations supply testing and repair-shop technology, diagnostic software, service training, and information services.

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and knowledge while working with cutting-edge technology. We want you to enjoy what you do and feel inspired to contribute your best to our customers and to the growth of our business. We believe that by cultivating a work environment that encourages personal and professional growth, enjoyment, and inspiration, we can achieve great things together.

Join us at Bosch Mobility Aftermarket and help us shape the future of mobility!

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our team as an Associate Vehicle Data Analyst.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, investigating complex problems, identifying patterns, and transforming information into actionable insights. The successful candidate will play a key role in improving the quality, coverage, and performance of our vehicle diagnostic solutions for major North American automotive brands.

As an Associate Vehicle Data Analyst, you will leverage vehicle diagnostic data, service information, customer feedback, and product performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement, uncover root causes of issues, and support strategic product decisions. You will work closely with software developers, validation teams, content authors, and global engineering organizations to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction.

Success in this role requires a combination of analytical thinking, technical curiosity, automotive knowledge, and a passion for continuous learning.

Core Responsibilities:

Data Analysis & Investigation

- Analyze vehicle diagnostic data, validation results, quality metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities.

- Perform root-cause investigations to determine underlying causes of product quality issues and coverage gaps.

- Research and interpret OEM service information, repair procedures, and vehicle system documentation to support product development and validation activities.

- Develop data-driven recommendations to improve product quality, reliability, and customer experience.

- Convert large volumes of technical and diagnostic information into actionable insights for engineering and business teams.

Product & Validation Support

- Support the development and maintenance of vehicle coverage strategies for assigned automotive brands and vehicle platforms.

- Collaborate with validation teams to define test coverage priorities and ensure critical vehicle systems are adequately validated.

- Participate in the investigation and resolution of quality issues, Open Point Lists (OPLs), and customer-reported concerns.

- Monitor product performance and customer usage data to help prioritize future development efforts.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with software developers, content authors, validation engineers, and global engineering teams.

- Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and evidence-based decision making.

- Contribute to the development of best practices, analytical methodologies, and reporting capabilities.

jobs.description:
栃木工場（TgP)は約500人の従業員の皆さんが働く、日本のVMの主要工場です。私たちはESP/ABS、吸気圧センサーやiBoosterなどの製品を生産しており、さらに成長を続けています。また、TgPは2輪向けABSの「Lead Manufacturing Plant」を担っており、2輪ABSの他拠点をリードするという特別な役割を果たしています。

生産管理部は、その中で部品の調達から、生産計画、お客様への完成品のお届けに至るまでサプライチェーンをコーディネーションする重要な役割を担っています。

Tochigi Plant (TgP) is one of the major manufacturing locations in Japan for Vehicle Motion (VM) division with around 500 associates. We are further growing for the future with a good mixture of product portfolio including ABS/ESP, low pressure sensor, and iBooster2. TgP is an unique plant in that we have “Lead Manufacturing Function” in Motorcycle ABS, and we are coordinating and leading other plants for motorcycle ABS.

Logistics department plays an important role in coordinating overall supply chain starting from parts procurement, production planning and delivery to customer.

業務内容

ロジスティクスにおけるデジタル化の促進をご担当いただきます。また、ご自身の経験、適正等を考慮して、生産/部品計画の業務を一部ご担当いただく可能性もございます。

- ロジスティクスにおけるDigital transformation推進

- 導入済みツール運用の仕組み、改善

- デジタルツールを使用した業務プロセス改善

- Digitalization strategy立案サポート

- Digitalization関連教育コーディネーション（計画立案と実施）

- 生産/部品計画

- 生産/部品計画および進捗管理

- 受注/発注管理および海外拠点や営業、サプライヤーとのインターフェース、折衝

- 共通業務

- KPI管理

- 改善活動の企画と実施（品質、コスト、納期遵守）

業務をとおして貢献できること・学べる事

刻一刻と変化するサプライチェーンのダイナミックさを体感したり、チームワークで困難な状況を乗り越えていくところにやりがいや面白さがあります。生産管理としての専門性を身につけることだけではなく、国内外のステークホルダーとコミュニケーションをとる中で、ネットワークを広げることができ、様々なチャレンジを通して、ご自身の成長を感じることができると思います。また、現在、ボッシュではデジタルトランスフォーメーションに積極的取り組んでいます。一例として、栃木工場生産管理部でも、製品・部品の自動搬送ロボットやロボティックプロセスオートメーションの導入を実施しています。今回は、今後この活動にさらに力を入れるべく、特に、ロジスティクスエリアにおいて、デジタルツールを使用して実現できる新たなロジスティクスの構築にチャンレンジしてくださる方を募集しています。

Your Responsibility & Tasks:

You will be assigned as a key planner for accelerating digitalization in logistics. Depending on your experience and aptitude, you may also be engaged in tasks involving production/procurement planning.

- Digital transformation in logistics

- Improvement of already introduced digitalization methods

- New process improvement using digitalization tools

- Support in Digitalization strategy development

- Coordination of Digitalization trainings in logistics

- Production/Procurement planner tasks

- Production/Procurement planning and progress management

- Order management and Interface to sales and overseas plants

- Common tasks

- Logistics KPI tracking

- Improvement activities (quality, cost, delivery)

What you can expect

You can experience the dynamics of global supply chain by engaging yourself to the ever-changing logistics world. Overcoming challenges with your colleagues will be interesting to you. Not only will you get logistics expertise, but also you will extend your network through communication with a various stakeholders including overseas/suppliers and Bosch plants. You can feel your own growth through exciting challenges. Particularly, Bosch is strategically focusing on digital transformation. For example, in logistics at Tochigi plant, we have introduced automatic transportation by robots and robotic process automation. In order to further accelerate our digital transformation in logistics, we would welcome talent who will take challenges and work together to develop new logistics through digitalization.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager / Change Manager_ EM
Masterarbeit: Datengetriebene Identifikation und Prognose der thermischen Flexibilität in Wärmepumpensystemen für Wohngebäude (w/m/div.)
jobs.description:
Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.

Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wärmepumpen in Wohngebäuden können elektrische Flexibilität bereitstellen, indem sie die im gesamten Energiesystem verfügbare thermische Speicherkapazität nutzen – einschließlich der thermischen Gebäudemasse, der Trinkwarmwasser-(TWW-)Speicherung sowie, sofern vorhanden, Pufferspeicher. Bosch verfügt bereits über Konzepte zur thermischen Charakterisierung, zur Flexibilitätsschätzung sowie zur Prognose des Energieverbrauchs. Ihre Abschlussarbeit soll daher darauf fokussieren, diese Konzepte operativ nutzbar zu machen, indem systemspezifische thermische Eigenschaften aus Monitoringdaten identifiziert und zur Prognose des Energieverbrauchs sowie der verfügbaren Flexibilität eingesetzt werden. Die Fragestellung lautet: Wie können die thermischen Eigenschaften und nutzbaren Speicherkapazitäten von Wärmepumpen-Energiesystemen in Wohngebäuden – einschließlich thermischer Gebäudemasse, TWW-Speicher sowie Pufferspeicher – automatisch aus Monitoringdaten identifiziert werden, und wie kann diese Information in Prognosekonzepte integriert werden, um den elektrischen Energieverbrauch sowie die verfügbare thermische Flexibilität zu schätzen?

- Sie prüfen bestehende Bosch-Modellierungskonzepte zur thermischen Charakterisierung und Flexibilitätsschätzung und analysieren empirische Feld-Monitoringdaten, um Datenpipelines, Ein-/Ausgabeanforderungen sowie relevante Datenqualitätskriterien zu definieren.

- Darüber hinaus identifizieren Sie automatisch gebäude- und speicherspezifische thermische Parameter (z. B. thermischer Widerstand, Wärmekapazität). Zudem haben Sie die Möglichkeit, datengetriebene Identifikationsansätze gegenüber Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Neural ODEs) hinsichtlich Parameterplausibilität, Rechenaufwand sowie Modellgenauigkeit zu benchmarken.

- Außerdem integrieren Sie die parametrierten Modelle in Prognosepipelines, um elektrische Lastprofile zu schätzen und zeitabhängige Flexibilitätsmargen zu quantifizieren. Sie vergleichen Prognosen sowie Flexibilitätskennzahlen auf Ebene einzelner Gebäude und aggregierter Flotten (einschließlich statistischer Analyse der Aggregationseffekte).

- Im Rahmen Ihrer Abschlussarbeit entwickeln Sie einen automatisierten End-to-End-Prototypen-Workflow, der Datenvorverarbeitung, Modellparameteridentifikation, Instanziierung sowie Prognosegenerierung abdeckt. Sie validieren den Prototypen anhand von Messdaten und dokumentieren Ihre Ergebnisse sowie die Grenzen des Systems.

- Während Ihrer Tätigkeit vergleichen Sie Daten auf Haus- und Flottenebene und analysieren Verbrauchsmuster auf Basis von Monitoringdaten. Optional führen Sie eine detailliertere statistische Analyse von Aggregationsmethoden durch.

- Nicht zuletzt umfasst Ihre Aufgabe eine Bewertung des Identifikations- und Prognose-Workflows auf Basis realer Monitoringdaten, einen Benchmark-Vergleich von Identifikationsmethoden (z. B. RC-Modelle vs. Neural ODEs) sowie der Skalierung (Einzelhaushalt vs. Flottenaggregation) und konkrete praxisnahe Empfehlungen für den Einsatz automatisierter Flexibilitätsprognosen in zukünftigen Bosch Energielösungen für Wohngebäude.

jobs.description:
Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

1. 供应商管理

1.1 订单下达与跟进

- 及时向供应商下达采购订单, 准确传达订单的所有细节，如数量、规格和交货日期等。

- 跟进订单以确保按时交货，及时解决采购过程中出现的任何问题或延误，如运输问题或质量差异。

1.2 商务谈判

- 与供应商就条款和条件进行谈判，例如寄售协议，物流协议等，以优化成本和服务水平。

2. 库存控制

2.1 库存规划

- 依据交货期、需求波动和供应可靠性等因素，设置合理安全库存水平。

- 根据不同物料以及供应商特性，合理设置计划参数，以达到成本与供给理想平衡

2.2库存监控

-识别滞销和过时的物料，并采取适当措施避免物料呆滞或者清理库存。

3.1 与生产，工程和研发部门密切合作，确保新产品开发和生产流程有充足的物料供应。

3.2 物流和仓储团队协调，确保公司内部物料流转顺畅。

3.3 与商务采购合作，持续提高供应商以及供应链整体绩效。

3.4 与其他团队合作，减少物流成本。

Lead Engineer – eAxle Thermal System
jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch.

As a Lead Engineer , you will act as the thermal expert for next-generation electric axle systems, ensuring optimal thermal performance, efficiency and cost competitiveness across platform and customer projects. Working closely with international and cross-functional teams, you will drive the development of innovative thermal management solutions for eMobility applications and contribute to the success of future electric powertrain systems.

Your tasks:

► Acting as the thermal expert for eAxle systems, ensuring thermal performance and cost competitiveness throughout the product lifecycle

► Developing, evaluating and implementing thermal system concepts and solutions in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams

► Performing system-level thermal simulations and predicting the thermal behavior of eAxle components and systems

► Planning, defining and executing thermal measurements, including result analysis, interpretation and validation activities

► Developing and continuously improving thermal simulation models while ensuring correlation between simulation and measurement data

► Serving as the main interface for thermal-related topics between electric machine, gearbox and power electronics domains, as well as internal and external stakeholders

► Supporting project teams by taking ownership of thermal system deliverables, including requirement analysis, technical presentations and customer communication

► Providing technical guidance on thermal management topics and supporting system-level decision-making

► Supporting software-related topics at system level, including thermal management functions, control strategies and calibration concepts

► Contributing to the continuous development of thermal engineering methodologies, tools and processes
jobs.requirements_raw:
► Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Thermodynamics or a related field

► Strong expertise in thermodynamics, heat transfer and thermal system behavior at both component and system level

► Solid understanding of electric powertrain systems and the interaction of key eMobility components

► Experience with thermal management and cooling concepts in electrified powertrain applications

► Experience with system simulation tools such as AMESIM, Simscape, Simulink or similar platforms

► Proficiency in MATLAB and common engineering tools (e.g. DOORS, MS Office)

► Understanding of 3D FEA and CFD simulation methods and related tools (e.g. ANSYS, Fluent)

► Good understanding of automotive embedded software architecture and system interactions

► Ability to formulate software-related requirements and understand software implementation from a system perspective

► Understanding of software-controlled thermal management strategies is an advantage

► Basic understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes as well as cost-efficient product design principles

► Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

► Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment

► Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams

► Fluent English language skills (written and spoken)

日本の主要自動車メーカー（JOEM）向け次世代Digital Key Systemプロジェクトにおいて、顧客プロジェクトマネージャーとしてご活躍いただきます。

[チーム構成]

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

Bosch Cross-Domain Computing & ADAS (XC-CP) Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Automotive Head Unit and Home Appliance Linux/Android-based systems.

Together with other Bosch locations worldwide, we provide software solutions for navigation, vehicle functions, autonomous driving, camera, and IoT features to the car marker. Our team also contributes to Bosch smart home & IoT solutions through SW delivery to Home Appliance products.

Bosch XC is seeking a Software System Architect to drive the design and development of cutting-edge software solutions for our next-generation automotive technology portfolio. In this role, you will collaborate with Global and Regional Architecture teams to define scalable, high-performance software architectures that align with Bosch’s innovation goals in ADAS, Driver Assistance, and Cockpit Domains (IDC).

Responsibilities / Main Tasks of SW Architect:

- Design Software Architecture

- Define software architecture that fulfils the software requirements

- Make architectural decisions, document and communicate architecture

At Bosch, “Invented for Life” is what drives us and our vision of global future mobility. Bosch has an outstanding track record on pioneering key technologies worldwide which shapes the way we move. The next big milestone in our sight is to make autonomous vehicles a reality, bringing its benefits to today's roads.

We are looking for students in the machine learning and software development space who are interested in solving the hardest problems in the development and productization of automated driving with us.

We are looking for an accomplished student in the ML space with strong technical skills to work with us on the design, implementation, training and roll-out the next generation of AI-enabled robotics test system, a core component of the realization of self-driving vehicles. As an intern on the team, you will be working on all important aspects of the implementation to enable our R&D teams.

Responsibilities include:

- Design, implement and roll-out important aspects of our state-of-the-art robotics test framework, enabling the execution of sophisticated test campaigns on various hardware setups

- Define and execute the integration of AI features for test management and execution

- Work on data pipelines, model training and validation, and performance evaluation

- Support the integration and testing of our framework, as well as its continuous operation in production

- Continuously drive innovation by bringing the latest developments in academia to the table and evaluate them as potential candidate for the next version

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

🎁Q4 JOINING BONUS

Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Telematics Software Engineer with strong embedded Android experience to drive the migration of our Telematics Control Unit (TCU) software framework from Embedded Linux to Android (AOSP / Android Automotive), across both Commercial Vehicle / Off-Highway and Passenger Car programs. This is a foundational platform migration, not a feature port: you will re-architect vehicle-network interfaces, connectivity, diagnostics, and OTA mechanisms to run natively within the Android framework — HALs, system services, SELinux policy — while preserving the functional behavior, performance, and cybersecurity posture already proven on the current Linux platform. You will own the technical plan end-to-end and work directly with platform, cloud, and OEM customer teams to sequence it without disrupting shipping programs.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the technical strategy and execution plan for porting the existing embedded Linux telematics framework to Android (AOSP / Android Automotive), including a gap analysis of what changes at the HAL, native service, and application layers.

- Re-architect vehicle-network interfaces (CAN / CAN-FD, J1939, ISOBUS, UDS, DoIP) as Vehicle HAL (VHAL) extensions or native AIDL/HIDL services, preserving existing signal processing and diagnostics behavior.

- Port connectivity and cloud communication — 4G/5G modem integration via the RIL/Telephony framework, GNSS, MQTT/HTTPS telemetry — to Android system services.

- Migrate OTA (FOTA/SOTA) update mechanisms, remote diagnostics, and fleet-management data services to Android's update framework (A/B seamless updates or equivalent), maintaining feature parity with the current implementation.

- Adapt regulatory and safety-related features (eCall / ERA-GLONASS, tachograph and driver-data interfaces, emissions/usage reporting) to run correctly within Android's process and permission model.

- Define and enforce SELinux policies, Android permission boundaries, and secure/verified-boot equivalents to preserve or improve the platform's cybersecurity posture (ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156) through the migration.

- Build and maintain the Android build system (AOSP repo/manifest, device tree, BSP integration) for the target TCU hardware.

- Define a test strategy that validates functional and performance parity between the Linux and Android implementations before cutover — regression suite, bench testing, and vehicle-level validation.

- Collaborate with platform/BSP, cloud/backend, and OEM customer teams to sequence the migration against shipping programs; define a phased or parallel-run rollout plan.

- Document architecture decisions and migration learnings, and mentor engineers ramping up on embedded Android.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

- 7+ years of embedded software development in automotive, telematics, or IoT, with strong C/C++ (C++14 or later) and Java/Kotlin for Android-layer work.

- Direct, hands-on experience with embedded Android / AOSP: HAL development (VHAL or custom HALs), AIDL/HIDL, system services, SELinux policy, and the Android build system (Soong/Make, repo/manifest).

- Experience with cellular connectivity (LTE/5G modems, RIL integration on Android), GNSS, and cloud protocols (MQTT, TLS, REST).

- Experience with Android OTA update mechanisms (A/B seamless updates or equivalent) and secure boot / verified boot concepts.

- Proven experience carrying a non-trivial embedded system through a platform/OS migration — able to speak concretely to gap analysis, phased cutover, and regression risk.

- Proficiency with automotive tooling: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, bus analyzers, debuggers (JTAG/Lauterbach), Git, CI/CD.

- Solid experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto/Buildroot) telematics platforms — you need to understand what you're migrating from as well as to.

- Solid knowledge of vehicle networks and protocols: CAN / CAN-FD, J1939, UDS, DoIP; experience with at least one of ISOBUS, FMS, or Automotive Ethernet / SOME-IP.

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior production experience specifically with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and its Vehicle HAL.

- AUTOSAR Classic or Adaptive experience alongside Android.

- Knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 (cybersecurity), and ISO 26262 (functional safety) as applied to an Android-based platform.

- Experience with eCall / ERA-GLONASS, digital tachograph (EU 165/2014), or emissions telematics (e.g., OBD-over-telematics, China GB17691).

- Familiarity with Automotive SPICE or comparable structured development processes.

- Experience working with global OEM customers and multi-site development teams.

jobs.title: Director Consulting – M&A Operations (f/m/div.)
jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch.

The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application!

Bosch Management Consulting (BMC/IC) is the internal management consultancy of the Bosch Group. We focus on strategic in-house projects that drive the effective transformation and continued development of our businesses within Bosch. Our consulting teams support senior management within the Bosch Group on strategic, organizational, and operational topics and help improve the business performance of our customers substantially and sustainably.

We work on portfolio elements covering topics such as

- Restructuring & M&A Operations

- Performance Improvement and Value Creation Plans

- Operational Excellence

- Market & Strategy

At BMC/IC, you work in cross-functional teams in close collaboration with our internal customers on complex projects and provide impactful and tailored solutions for top management across the Bosch Group. We provide an inspiring place to work and excellent career opportunities within the entire Bosch Group.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead consulting projects or take responsibility for critical workstreams within complex M&A, Post-Merger Integration (PMI), and carve-out programs.

- Scope consulting engagements jointly with the responsible Partner and customer and ensure successful delivery of project objectives.

- Drive Post-Merger Integration initiatives with a focus on integration governance, Day-One readiness, synergy realization, and target operating model implementation.

- Support carve-out situations, including pre-transaction studies, Transition Service Agreement (TSA) and Service Level Agreement (SLA) negotiations, as well as Sign-to-Close activities.

- Support operational due diligence and integration readiness assessments as part of strategic M&A transactions.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of integration and separation programs.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, regulatory developments, and best practices in M&A operations.

- Prepare and present detailed analyses, recommendations, and decision materials to senior management and executive leadership.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.

- several years of professional experience in management consulting, corporate development, transaction advisory, M&A integration, or related environments.

- Experience in both management consulting and industrial environments is a strong advantage.

- Proven experience in Post-Merger Integration (PMI), carve-outs, separation management, and/or M&A transformation programs.

- Strong understanding of M&A processes across the transaction lifecycle, including operational due diligence, integration planning, Day-One readiness, synergy realization, and separation management.

- Proven ability to lead complex projects and/or critical workstreams in international and cross-functional environments.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a deep understanding of business operations.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of analytical tools such as KNIME, Alteryx, or Power BI is a plus.

- Excellent team player, self-motivated with a “can-do” attitude and strong customer orientation.

- Fluent in English and German.

jobs.title: Praktikum in der Entwicklung von Festoxid-Zellen (w/m/div.)
jobs.description:
Bei Bosch gestalten wir die Zukunft, indem wir hochwertige Technologien und Dienstleistungen entwickeln, die begeistern und das Leben der Menschen bereichern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeitenden ist felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, wir haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und wir inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Machen Sie mit und spüren Sie den Unterschied. Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Eine zentrale Herausforderung auf dem Weg zur Klimaneutralität ist die Speicherung von Strom aus erneuerbaren Quellen, beispielsweise in Form von Wasserstoff. Der Betrieb der Festoxid-Zelle (SOC) im Elektrolysemodus als Festoxid-Elektrolysezelle (SOEC) ermöglicht die direkte Umwandlung elektrischer Energie in chemische Energie. Aufgrund ihrer Betriebstemperatur von 600 °C und darüber weist die SOEC die höchste elektrische Effizienz unter den Elektrolysetechnologien auf und ist damit eine sehr vielversprechende Technologie für die Wasserstoffwirtschaft der Zukunft. Um unser Verständnis der während des SOEC-Betriebs ablaufenden Prozesse zu verbessern, werden die Zellen experimentell charakterisiert, um ihre Leistungsfähigkeit zu bestimmen und Daten zur Parametrisierung oder Validierung physikalischer Modelle bereitzustellen, die die Zellleistung oder Alterung vorhersagen.

Während Ihres Praktikums werden Sie SOEC-Einzelzellen experimentell mithilfe elektrochemischer Methoden charakterisieren, beispielsweise mittels elektrochemischer Impedanzspektroskopie sowie Strom-Spannungs-Kennlinien. Sie unterstützen die Inbetriebnahme eines neuen Prüfstands, einschließlich der Erstinbetriebnahme – von Software- bis zu Hardwarekomponenten – einschließlich hochpräziser Messgeräte. Nicht zuletzt werten Sie experimentelle Daten aus und präsentieren die Ergebnisse einem interdisziplinären Team.

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:

1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Application Period: 26 Sep 2026 to 14 Oct 2026

Interview date: 05, 13 & 15 Oct 2026

Onboarding date: 16 Oct 2026 & 2 Nov 2026

As a Fresher Embedded Software Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:

- Analyze and clarify software requirements.

- Develop, integrate, and test embedded software based on defined requirements.

- Support low-level and high-level software design for embedded modules.

- Perform software integration and test execution.

- Document development and test results.

- Analyze and debug software issues when required.

- Collaborate with experienced engineers and global development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

Technical Skills:

- Good knowledge of C/C++ programming.

- Basic understanding of microcontrollers and embedded systems.

- Knowledge of Python, Perl, or other scripting languages is a plus.

- Basic knowledge of communication protocols and/or sensors is an advantage.

Other Skills:

- Good problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Willingness to learn and develop technical expertise in the automotive domain.

- Able to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing.

jobs.description:
Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.

Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf deine Bewerbung!

Möchtest du mit deiner Abschlussarbeit einen echten Beitrag zur Kreislaufwirtschaft leisten und die Weichen für nachhaltige Rohstoffgewinnung stellen? Bei uns erhältst du die Gelegenheit, die energetische, wirtschaftliche und genehmigungsrechtliche Machbarkeit der thermischen Trocknung von Calciumfluorid-Fällungsschlämmen aus Abwasseranlagen zu untersuchen und so direkt an der Gestaltung einer ressourcenschonenden Zukunft mitzuwirken.

- Im Rahmen deiner Abschlussarbeit recherchierst du umfassend zur Bedeutung von Calciumfluorid als kritischem Rohstoff, analysierst globale Märkte und seine vielfältigen Anwendungen. Zudem beleuchtest du bestehende Recycling- und Verwertungsmethoden in verschiedenen Branchen, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf die Fluorchemie.

- Du screenst geeignete Schlammtrocknungsverfahren wie Bandtrockner, Festbettreaktoren oder Wirbelschichtanlagen und untersuchst die spezifischen technischen sowie logistischen Herausforderungen am Standort Reutlingen.

- Verschiedene energetische Betriebsweisen vergleichst du – von Strom über Gas und Öl bis hin zu regenerativen Energien.

- Darüber hinaus erstellst du eine detaillierte Lebenszykluskostenanalyse (LCC), in der du die Investitions- und Betriebskosten einer Trocknungsanlage den potenziellen Einsparungen durch reduzierte Entsorgungs- und Transportkosten gegenüberstellst.

- Nicht zuletzt ermittelst du die zu erwartenden Emissionen wie Staub, Fluorwasserstoff, Lärm und Geruch, erarbeitest passende Minderungsmaßnahmen und recherchierst die erforderlichen immissionsschutz- und abfallrechtlichen Genehmigungen (BImSchG, KrWG) für den Anlagenbetrieb.

- Erfahrungen und Know-how: Kenntnisse im Abfall- und Gefahrstoffrecht; Fähigkeit, Gesetzestexte zu analysieren und zu interpretieren; sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (insbesondere PowerPoint, Word, Excel)

- Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: dir gelingt es, mit hoher Einsatzbereitschaft selbstständig und strukturiert an komplexen Themen zu arbeiten

- Arbeitsalltag: deine Präsenz vor Ort ist erforderlich

- Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch
