Senior AI Research Scientist- Time-Series Foundational Models
jobs.description:
The Bosch Research and Technology Center North America with offices in Sunnyvale, California, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Cambridge, Massachusetts is a part of the global Bosch Group (www.bosch.com), a company with over 70 billion euro revenue, 400,000 employees worldwide, a very diverse product portfolio, and a history spanning over 125 years. The Research and Technology Center North America (RTC-NA) is dedicated to providing technologies and system solutions for various Bosch business fields, primarily in the field of artificial intelligence, energy technologies, internet technologies, circuit design, semiconductors and wireless, as well as advanced MEMS design.

As a part of the global research, our AI research in Silicon Valley focuses on Foundation Models, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision & Mixed Reality, Cloud Robotics, Big Data Visual Analytics, Explainable AI (XAI), Data Science, AI System Engineering, Time-series Analysis. We develop scalable, intelligent, and trustworthy AIoT solutions for Bosch products and services in application areas such as automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), robotics, smart manufacturing, enterprise AI, health care, smart home and building solutions.

Originating from the AI research in Silicon Valley, our Foundation Model Powered AI Enablers group plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of industrial AI experiences for Bosch products and services. By fusing cutting-edge machine learning, data analysis, and interactive visualization technologies, we research and develop scalable and transparent AI & big data analytic solutions (e.g., audio, images, sensor logs) for a range of domains, including Industry 4.0 (I4.0), IoT, autonomous driving, and connected vehicles. Our award-winning team (IEEE VIS best paper & best paper runner-ups) actively collaborates with leading academic and industry groups to advance research ideas and disseminate findings in top AI conferences and journals, such as CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, TVCG.

Job Responsibilites:

- Develop and lead research of AI projects that label, predict, classify, cluster, describe and fuse multi-sensor data (including acoustic, telemetry timeseries signals, vibration, radar, lidar, image, Wi-Fi, and ultrasound data), to improve / enable advance driver assistance system (ADAS) functionality in vehicles and AI functionalities in other Bosch products.

- Architect, design and validate multi-modal deep learning and Timeseries Foundation Models (TSFM) to work with multivariate time series signals. Must have a grasp of both low and high frequency models.

- Integrate and extend timeseries models to leverage information from other auxiliary modalities such as videos and images to enhance context understanding.

- Offer expert insights to the management team in relevant technology sectors, aiding in strategic planning, R&D trajectory, and investment decisions.

- Stay abreast of the latest technological innovations, document and disseminate research findings through high-caliber publications and/or patent submissions.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Basic Qualifications

- Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline OR Masters degree with 2-3 years of preferred professional experience

- Expertise with Time Series FMs (beyond the time series task of forecasting)

- In-depth experience in signal processing for sensor data and their integration with deep-learning methods

- Proficiency in Python, PyTorch (including libraries such as torchaudio, torchvision, torchmetrics), familiarity with PyTorch Lightning

- A strong publication record in relevant venues such as ICASSP, NeurIPS, InterSpeech, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ICRA, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV or equivalent contributions to the field such as patents or significant open-source projects

- Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in industrial research

- Experience with one or more of the following areas: data-centric AI, synthetic data generation, agentic AI

- Proficiency with version control systems (Git), integrated development environment (VSCode or PyCharm) and experience with experiment tracking tools (MLFlow)

- Familiarity with high-performance computing systems and job schedulers (Slurm, LSF)

- Hands-on experience in product development in the above-mentioned areas for consumer/enterprise markets

- Experience leading projects with small teams, demonstrating the ability to mentor junior researchers and interns, manage project timelines, and deliver results within time constraints

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

🎁Q4 JOINING BONUS

Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary, subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead AI Safety & Security Engineer to own safety evaluation and security testing across Bosch's growing portfolio of AI-enabled products and internal tooling — large language model deployments and agentic AI systems (including Model Context Protocol – style tool-calling integrations), and the enterprise services they connect to. You will lead both sides of the same coin: whether an AI system behaves safely (does it refuse harmful requests, avoid unsafe recommendations, stay within its intended scope) and whether it is secure (can it be manipulated via prompt injection, tricked into misusing its tools, or made to leak data it shouldn't). This is a cross-business-unit mandate, not a single product line — you will build the practice largely from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and run safety evaluations for LLM-based features and AI agents: red-teaming for harmful, biased, or unsafe outputs; jailbreak and guardrail-bypass testing; systematic benchmarking against known safety failure modes.

- Design and run security testing for the same systems: prompt injection (direct and indirect), excessive agency, tool/plugin abuse, and confused-deputy risks in agentic and MCP-style tool-calling architectures.

- Build and maintain a threat model covering the full path from user input through model reasoning to tool execution — identifying where a safety failure and a security failure are really the same underlying gap.

- Verify human-in-the-loop and guardrail controls are architecturally sound wherever an AI agent can take a consequential action (a write to a business system, an automated communication, a code change) — not just present in a UI that can be talked around.

- Scope, brief, and review the output of external red-teaming/pentest vendors; write test specifications and acceptance criteria for AI-specific engagements.

- Track and apply emerging frameworks — OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act — translating new research into concrete internal test requirements before it becomes an incident.

- Partner with AI/ML engineering teams across business units to get safety and security reviewed into system design, not only tested after the fact.

- Produce evidence and documentation supporting AI governance and compliance needs (ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system, EU AI Act risk assessments, internal responsible-AI review processes).

- Build test tooling as needed: adversarial-prompt harnesses, automated jailbreak/red-team pipelines, and MCP/tool-schema fuzzers.

- Mentor engineers on safe and secure AI system design, and grow the practice as it scales across more teams and products.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

- 6+ years in security testing, AI/ML safety research, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of finding real issues in real systems.

- Practical experience testing or red-teaming LLM/agentic AI systems — prompt injection, jailbreaks, excessive agency, tool/plugin abuse — independent research or open-source contributions are acceptable given how new this specialty is.

- Working knowledge of at least one AI safety/governance framework (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and how it translates into concrete engineering requirements.

- Enough coding ability (Python and/or JavaScript/Node) to build evaluation harnesses and test tooling rather than rely solely on manual testing.

- Strong technical writing — comfortable producing findings and specifications that both engineers and governance/compliance stakeholders can act on directly.

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks.

- Traditional penetration testing background (web/API/network), OSCP or equivalent.

- Experience contributing to a formal AI governance or compliance program.

- Publications, CTF/red-team competition results, or open-source security tooling in the AI safety/security space.

- Experience mentoring or building out a small safety/security testing team.

Relevant Certifications (any of the following a plus)

- Offensive security / penetration testing — OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CEH.

- AI-specific security — ISC2 AI Security Certificate, EC-Council Certified Offensive AI Security Professional, or Certified AI Security Professional (CAISP).

- AI governance / compliance — ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer, or IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP).

• Celebrate success: At Bosch, we celebrate you.

• Be yourself: At Bosch, we value values.

• Shape tomorrow: At Bosch, you change lives.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

- Support all maintenance calls to keep production equipment running at optimum efficiency, with due care given to part quality, throughput, and operator requirements. This includes, but is not limited to, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and tooling repairs. The highest degree of urgency to be given to all safety related calls and conditions.

- Perform regular PMs on the equipment through the PM schedules.

- Improve operations through the Maintenance Project List, Continuous Improvement Activities and 5S.

- Report any conditions of spare part shortage/absence or other required parts to the appropriate maintenance planner.

- Coordinate coverage for extended shifts and weekend work.

- Coordinate work (calls, projects, PMs, etc.) within the department with direction from Production Supervisors

- Troubleshoot electronic problems with actuators and sensors for mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic functions. Also included are servo hydraulics and servo pneumatics, high resolution positioning, load cells, AC servo drives, electro robotic systems, electronic test equipment.

- Operate and use equipment such as, multi-meter, oscilloscope, amp gauges, Siemens PG units, and computers.

- Develop PLC program improvements and changes as required with support from the PLC Tech.

- Maintain required 5S standards in department.

- Ensure SAP requirements are kept up to standard (work orders / PM’s).

- This position is 2nd shift, from 2-10pm.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Education and/or Experience:

- Knowledge of and experience with proper use of hand tools, machine tools, troubleshooting equipment, measuring tools, and leveling devices. Working knowledge of servo hydraulic mechanical, pneumatic and robotic systems.

- Knowledge of and experience in blueprint reading, understanding of metrics and electrical schematics, standards in industrial electricity equipment, and electrical safety rules.

- Understanding of electrical switch devices in relationship to a PLC controller.

- Must have post level education above high school in Industrial Mechanics or Electronics.

- Understand AC/DC circuits, motor wiring, electrical and safety codes for machine wiring, disconnects, fusing, wire sizing, PLC control wiring interface with other electrical devices and sensors.

- Understand board level electronics and how they control, i.e., robotic, speed control, positioning, servo valves and test equipment.

- Ability to read and understand hydraulic and pneumatic schematics.

- Must have flexible schedule – may be required to stay over / come in early / be on call for weekend support

- Understanding and working knowledge of hydraulic pumps, directional control valves, proportional valves, servo valves, oil flow and pressure controls, filtering, electro-pneumatics, and specific equipment safety rules.

jobs.description:
Bosch, a leading global supplier of technology and services, has been present in Malaysia since 1923, through its network of partners and distributors. Today, Bosch is present in six locations throughout the country, with Penang housing to the company’s largest high-tech engineering hub in Southeast Asia with production focusing on mobility electronics, power tools and semiconductor.

All four business sectors (Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology) have operations in the country.

Main Responsibilities:

- Assist in daily operational activities related to foreign worker management.

jobs.description:
Die Marke Bosch Deutschland der Bosch Home Comfort Group bietet intuitiv-einfache Lösungen für komfortables Heizen, Lüftung, Klima und warmes Wasser in Wohngebäuden. Mit faszinierenden, ressourcenschonenden Produkten und umfassenden Services verbessern wir die Lebensqualität und leisten unseren Beitrag zur Energieeinsparung in Deutschland.

Die Bosch Home Comfort Group freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung!

- Sie akquirieren aktiv neue Kundschaft und bauen langfristige Beziehungen zu Großhändlern, Installateurinnen bzw. Installateuren und Heizungsbauerinnen bzw. -bauern in Ihrem Verkaufsgebiet Arnsberg, Attendorn, Brilon, Menden, Meschede, Schmallenberg, Sundern, Warstein, Winterberg und Iserlohn.

- Zudem beraten Sie unsere Kundschaft umfassend in kaufmännischen sowie technischen Fragen, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu finden und deren Bedürfnisse optimal zu erfüllen.

- Ebenso übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Erreichung der Absatz- und Umsatzziele, indem Sie strategisch planen und Ihre Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent umsetzen.

- Ausbildung: technische Ausbildung, möglichst Meister:in, Techniker:in im Heizungsbau oder im Elektrohandwerk mit kaufmännischem Verständnis

- Erfahrungen und Know-how: mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in vergleichbarer Aufgabenstellung im Vertrieb unserer Branche; gute PC-Kenntnisse

- Sprachen: sehr gutes Deutsch

jobs.description:
Mit Bosch nach Berlin: Dein Neuanfang in der Hauptstadt!

Möchtest du deine Ideen in nutzbringende und sinnvolle Technologien verwandeln? Ob im Bereich Mobility Solutions, Consumer Goods, Industrial Technology oder Energy and Building Technology – mit uns verbesserst du die Lebensqualität der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt.

Willkommen bei Bosch.

Rund um den Globus steigt die Nachfrage nach Sicherheits- und Kommunikationslösungen, die den Menschen das Gefühl von Schutz und Geborgenheit geben. Der Bosch Geschäftsbereich Building Technologies ist einer der führenden Anbieter in diesem wachsenden Markt.

Wir suchen dich, um am Standort Berlin / Brandenburg den langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens zu sichern. Du bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung und einen spannenden Neuanfang in der pulsierenden Metropole Berlin? Wir unterstützen dich dabei!

Die Bosch Sicherheitssysteme Montage und Service GmbH freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

Von Brandmeldeanlagen über Einbruchmeldeanlagen bis hin zu sensorgestützten Lösungen: Dank unserer innovativen Technologien sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen sich in Gebäuden sicher fühlen können. Und mit dir suchen wir jemanden, der diese Systeme vor Ort beim Kunden im Gebiet Berlin / Brandenburg realisiert!

Du denkst über einen Umzug nach Berlin nach und möchtest dort beruflich durchstarten? Großartig! Wir helfen dir dabei, deinen Start in der Hauptstadt reibungslos zu gestalten. Werde Teil von "Mit Bosch nach Berlin" und baue dir ein neues Leben in einer der spannendsten Städte Europas auf!

Deine Aufgaben:

- Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Instandsetzung von Brandmelde- und Einbruchmeldesystemen sowie andere technische Dienstleistungen

- Erstellung der benötigten Anlagendokumentationen

- Übergabe der betriebsbereiten Systeme an den Kunden, Abnahme mit Behörden etc.

- Kundenorientierte Arbeitszeit

- Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst außerhalb der Geschäftszeit

Wir bieten dir:

- deine Wohnregion als Einsatzgebiet (im Raum Berlin / Brandenburg)

- Eine interessante vielseitige Tätigkeit mit Perspektiven in einem Großunternehmen

- Leistungsorientierte Entlohnung und Sonderzahlungen

- 30 Tage Urlaub und flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Firmen-KFZ mit der Möglichkeit zur bundesweiten Privatnutzung

- Laptop und Smartphone mit der Möglichkeit zur Privatnutzung

- Hochwertige Ausstattung an Arbeitsmitteln

- Umfangreiche Fortbildungsangebote und Aufstiegschancen

- Paten- & Einarbeitungsprogramm ab dem 1. Arbeitstag

- Gemeinsame Zielorientierung in einem dynamischen Team

- Zahlreiche Corporate Benefits für Bosch-Mitarbeitende

Ein Neuanfang in einer neuen Stadt ist aufregend. Damit du ganz entspannt starten kannst, stehen wir dir bei der Organisation deines Umzugs mit Rat und Tat zur Seite. Frag uns im Kennenlernen gerne danach!

jobs.description:

Do you envision a future where logistics processes are seamlessly integrated and driven by cutting-edge SAP S/4HANA solutions? - Join us as a Lead Developer SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Logistics and play a key role in Bosch Rexroth's global digital transformation. Bring your expertise to the forefront and lead the charge in designing and implementing innovative logistics solutions within SAP S/4HANA, helping optimize warehousing, transportation, and logistics processes worldwide.

In this role you will be working closely with Business Experts, Architects, and Development Teams. You will also turn complex requirements into scalable solutions while shaping the technical direction of our Supply Chain landscape.

Your responsibilities:

- Analyze customer requirements in the areas of inbound and outbound logistics and advise stakeholders on the best technical implementation approaches.

- Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions for SAP logistics modules, including Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Logistics Execution (LE), and Transportation Management (TM).

- Create and review comprehensive solution concepts, validate them through Proof of Concepts, and present technical alternatives and recommendations to project committees.

- Evaluate technical implementation options with regard to feasibility, risks, costs, development effort, and long-term maintainability.

- Estimate custom development scope, required capacities, costs, and potential technical debt.

- Coordinate and guide development activities throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Promote knowledge sharing within the team and actively contribute to code reviews and design reviews.

- Mentor developers and support the continuous improvement of development practices and solution quality.

- Support the global rollout of SAP applications and assist key users during deployment and introduction phases across international locations.

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.

- Strong expertise in ABAP development.

- Practical experience implementing and developing solutions within: SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), SAP Logistics Execution (LE), SAP Transportation Management (TM).

- Experience leading and mentoring development teams.

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate technical options, implementation effort, risks, and long-term maintainability.

- Solid understanding of Agile development methodologies.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.

- Experience working in large international transformation programs.

- German language skills.

What will make you successful?

- Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to balance standard SAP solutions and business-specific needs.

- Pragmatic approach to decision-making, considering quality, delivery speed, and long-term sustainability.

- Passion for sharing knowledge and supporting team development.

With its five product lines of compact hydraulics Bosch Rexroth Oil Control SpA, with factories in the province of Modena and Reggio Emilia and over 1,300 employees, has been producing and marketing compact hydraulic components for multiple applications for over 40 years, from aerial platforms to cranes, earth-moving machinery, agricultural machinery, industrial applications.

What characterizes Bosch Rexroth Oil Control S.p.A. is the ability to study customized solutions in relation to each specific customer requirement. For this reason, the products of Bosch Rexroth Oil Control S.p.A. they are synonymous with quality and represent a guarantee for the global market.

In industrial hydraulics, Bosch Rexroth is actively shaping the transition from conventional to intelligent and connected hydraulics. This opens up enormous potential for the easy and economical integration of machines and systems into modern industrial environments.

Our R&D department based in Nonantola (MO) is a center of global competence for Compact Hydraulic products.

Are you ready to join Bosch Rexroth Oil Control SpA?

Are you a final-year student, recent graduate, or soon-to-be graduate in Mechanical Engineering or a related field?

This is your opportunity to challenge yourself, showcase your skills, and take the first important step towards an exciting professional career at Bosch Rexroth Oil Control SpA.

Where?

Bosch Rexroth Oil Control SpA – Nonantola (MO), Italy

Your professional future starts here!

If you are passionate about the industrial sector, curious, motivated, and eager to develop both technical and commercial skills, this could be the opportunity you have been waiting for.

We are looking for young talents ready to embark on a professional development journey in a technical-commercial environment, with the goal of building strong expertise in hydraulics and industrial applications.

What do we offer?

A 24-month professional development program through an apprenticeship contract in Bosch Rexroth Oil Control SpA – Nonantola (MO), designed to help you develop technical, application, and commercial skills through the support of experienced professionals and hands-on experience in the field.

At the end of the program, based on the skills acquired, your demonstrated aptitude, and organizational needs, you may pursue one of the following career paths:

APPLICATION ENGINEER

Key responsibilities will include:

- Technical Support: analyze customer requirements and size and select the most suitable hydraulic components for different applications.

- Solution Development: collaborate with the Engineering Department to define and customize product configurations.

- Technical & Commercial Offers: prepare technical documentation and preliminary drawings to support commercial offers.

SALES ENGINEER

Key responsibilities will include:

- New Business Development: identify and approach potential customers and distributors.

- Customer Relationship Management: act as the main point of contact for customers, understanding their technical needs and application requirements.

- Commercial Offers: prepare commercial quotations, define standard prices and terms, and support delivery planning in collaboration with the Technical Office.

- Interest in the industrial sector and in developing both technical and commercial expertise

Join our international semiconductor team and help shape the next generation of consumer and automotive integrated circuits. As a Digital Verification Engineer, you will verify advanced Mixed-Signal and System-on-Chip (SoC) ASICs using state-of-the-art verification methodologies, leading EDA tools, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

Design and develop scalable, reusable verification environments for complex ICs, ensuring robust product quality and accelerating successful first silicon bring-up.

jobs.description:

About the Role

As an Expert for High-Performance SoC BSP Integration, you will play a key role in building and integrating the foundational software stack for next-generation high-performance System-on-Chip (SoC) and Chiplet platforms. You will work deep within BSP, POSIX/Linux/QNX environments, developing and optimizing kernel modules and device drivers, porting low-level software across platforms, and enabling reliable integration with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe and UCIe. With hands-on expertise spanning bootloaders, Linux kernel, device drivers, and SoC architecture, you will contribute to the performance, scalability, and technical excellence of Bosch’s Automotive Chiplet Systems (ACS) project.

Learn more about Bosch’s Automotive Chiplet technology: https://www.bosch-semiconductors.com/stories-and-events/chiplet-revolution/

Your main responsibilities

- You will develop advanced software modules and drivers specifically for the POSIX operating system (e.g. QNX).

- You will design and develop robust Linux kernel modules.

- You will port existing Linux drivers (kernel and user Space) to specific Linux distribution environment to ensure seamless integration and functionality.

- You will develop and contribute to multi-layer Continuous Integration (CI) environments.

- Experience with Linux, QNX, or other POSIX-based operating systems.

- Knowledge of GNU toolchains and Requirements Engineering tools such as Codebeamer.

jobs.description:
At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other.

As Lead Product Manager for MyComputer, you will shape one of the largest digital workplace products within Bosch Digital. MyComputer supports hundreds of thousands of users worldwide through a global ecosystem of internal teams and external service providers.

Your decisions will directly influence employee experience, business continuity, operational performance, supplier effectiveness, and financial outcomes. This is an opportunity to lead a product with global reach and help transform how workplace technology is planned, delivered, and continuously improved across Bosch.

Your role

You will have end-to-end responsibility for the strategy, performance, and lifecycle of MyComputer. Acting as the central point of product accountability, you will connect customer needs, business priorities, operational realities, supplier capabilities, and technical considerations.

A key focus of the role will be establishing forward-looking product planning assumptions that support lifecycle, sourcing, investment, and portfolio decisions.

You will also contribute to strengthening Product Management practices across End Device Products by sharing expertise, promoting effective approaches, and supporting greater consistency across the organization.

What you will do:

Define and evolve the product

- Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap.

- Identify customer needs and translate them into valuable product outcomes.

- Prioritize initiatives based on user value, business impact, operational feasibility, risk, and cost.

- Develop planning assumptions to support medium-term and long-term lifecycle, demand, sourcing, investment, and portfolio decisions.

- Lead product evolution initiatives, including service modernization, automation, sourcing strategies, and hardware lifecycle optimization.

Drive performance and customer value

- Define meaningful product KPIs and use them to measure adoption, service quality, operational performance, and value realization.

- Monitor product performance, planning assumptions, and forecast accuracy.

- Analyze deviations and coordinate corrective actions when needed.

- Promote a consistent, high-quality user experience across global markets and organizational units.

- Balance customer value with total cost of ownership, operational efficiency, and business priorities.

Lead through collaboration

- Build alignment across business, technology, finance, operations, procurement, and service organizations.

- Coordinate decisions and delivery in a global matrix environment.

- Create clarity around priorities, responsibilities, trade-offs, and expected outcomes.

- Work effectively with teams across different cultures and time zones.

- Support the development of Product Management capabilities and shared practices across End Device Products.

Steer partners and commercial outcomes

- Manage relationships with internal partners and external service providers.

- Contribute to sourcing initiatives, supplier governance, commercial steering, and contract-related decisions.

- Evaluate scenarios and make informed trade-offs between customer demand, operational constraints, supplier capabilities, risk, and financial targets.

- Help ensure benchmark-level service quality and cost efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.
jobs.requirements_raw:
We recognize that great candidates bring different combinations of experience and expertise. If you meet most of the required qualifications and are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply, even if your background does not match every preferred qualification.

Required qualifications

- Experience managing complex products or services across their lifecycle, including strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, and performance management.

- Ability to identify customer problems and translate them into clear product outcomes and actionable plans.

- Experience defining and using product KPIs to support decision-making and value realization.

- Strong business understanding, including the ability to evaluate risks, investments, costs, and strategic trade-offs.

- Experience building alignment and driving progress across multiple teams without relying on direct reporting relationships.

- Ability to collaborate with stakeholders from business, technology, finance, operations, procurement, or service delivery.

- A structured, data-informed approach to planning, forecasting, and performance improvement.

- Ability to work effectively in a global environment and coordinate activities across different cultures and time zones.

- Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Nice to have

- Experience with digital workplace, employee experience, enterprise technology, platform products, or IT services.

- Knowledge of workplace devices, endpoint management, device lifecycle management, or related service environments.

- Experience with supplier management, sourcing initiatives, commercial steering, or contract governance.

- Understanding of enterprise operating models, financial management, or governance structures.

- Experience using reporting, analytics, or automation to improve services and product performance.

- A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

- Training or certification in Product Management, IT Service Management, Agile ways of working, or business management.

- Working knowledge of German.

How you work

You are:

- Customer-focused and able to see both user needs and the wider business context.

- Strategic while remaining comfortable working with operational detail.

- Curious, adaptable, and motivated to improve products and services.

- Comfortable making decisions in complex situations where not every answer is immediately available.

- Able to communicate clearly, create alignment, and bring different perspectives together.

- Focused on outcomes, shared ownership, and continuous learning.

jobs.description:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

• Part of a packaging design team as a part of the physical logistics department.

• Responsible for developing and developed packing material and packaging concepts used for raw materials as well as finished goods in the supply chain.

• Design returnable and one-way packaging for the transport and handling of our products, raw material components or support with packaging design for our internal processes.

• Coordinate and implement optimization projects to achieve cost saving/avoidance by e.g. improving ergonomics and product density for existing packaging concepts.

• Coordinate packaging concepts implementation with internal and external suppliers (automotive suppliers and supplying Bosch plants) to assure a smooth ramp-up of new projects.

• Align new packaging development with the internal departments of all related AM-plants related to usage, ergonomics, logistics and technical characteristics of the designed packaging.

• With prepared packaging concepts, support competitive source of packaging suppliers.

• Release purchase of required tools for packaging production.

• Optimize internal processes to achieve reduction of packaging types to achieve standardization.

jobs.description:
Do you want to shape beneficial technologies with your ideas? Whether in mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology, or energy and building technology – with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe.

As part of Bosch Digital you will shape the digital future of Bosch. We create, innovate, operate and maintain differentiating products, services and solutions for all Bosch units. With our agile mindset and supportive culture, you’ll be empowered to grow and bring your ideas to life.

We are actively looking for an IT application specialist who will support Bosch in their digital transformation. You will be part of the +20 IT team of experts who support Bosch IT products and solutions in the area of Media Asset management (MAM). This role is focused on the MAM application from Aprimo which is a global leader in MAM solutions. The MAM application has a strong integration with the PT Product Information Management system (PIM) and together they form the backbone for any digital / ecommerce business within Bosch. As a MAM Development Lead, you get to work on exciting product data and integration topics. In your daily duties you will spend around 70% of work time on application development, configuration and support activities. The remaining time will be filled with project meetings, team integration and trainings.

Welcome to Bosch.

As part of our agile team, you will take responsibility and coordinate all technical developments of our Media Asset management (MAM) solutions. Furthermore, you take over responsibility for interface implementation and documentation in the area of PIM/MAM.

► Reliable implementation: You create detailed IT concepts in the area of MAM as well as for interfaces (Product Information Management-PIM). You manage the technical implementation of requirements and steer internal and external service providers to ensure that quality and development guidelines are met. You are an expert on data models.

► Customer orientation: You dive deep into the business processes and needs of the customers and understand the needs. You assess customer requirements from a technical perspective with respective effort estimations, and you assist in the design and development of proof of concept and prototypes.

► Think holistically: You ensure the high quality of the MAM solutions through appropriate acceptance tests regarding unit tests, usability and performance. You develop ideas for improving or optimizing the existing PIM/MAM solutions throughout the respective solution lifecycle.

► Live cooperation: You are the technical contact person for the team, the project management, the external development partners and our internal customers. You collaborate with Solution Managers and IT Architects on the delivery of Solution functionalities.

► Personality: Team-oriented and flexible

► Working style: Structured, analytical thinking, conceptual and self-reliant

► You have good knowledge of Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, related interfaces, and WEB applications

► Very good knowledge of REST APIs and basic programming skills in Java

► Systems & Data Formats: You possess basic Linux and SFTP knowledge, and you are familiar with databases, image structures, and tools to convert images. You also work comfortably with different data and media formats such as tiff, video, and images

► You are proficient in essential data exchange and processing technologies, including XML, JSON, and regex

► Languages: Good written and spoken English

- Bootloader Customization: Customize and configures Bootloader for RPUs and U-Boot for APUs,

- Implementation of secure boot

- Configure Linux kernel (integration of driver, optimization of performances)

- Interface Implementation & debugging: Integrate and troubleshoot communication interfaces (e.g. I2C, SPI, CAN, PCI, UCIe, USB, LPDDR, Camera, Display Port)

- Implement and debug communication protocols at hardware and software levels.

- Hardware-Software Integration: Perform board bring-up and validation for hardware platforms; Debug hardware interfaces using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers.

- Develop test tool for Hardware-specific test also covering system test level

Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

Looking for an innovative and highly experienced IoT Architect to lead the definition and development of scalable, secure, and robust end-to-end IoT solutions.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between embedded systems, connectivity, and cloud platforms, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance across the entire IoT ecosystem.

Tasks / Responsibilities:

• Translate business and system requirements into technical architecture.

• Define the end-to-end architecture for IoT solutions, encompassing device hardware/firmware, connectivity layers, cloud services, data pipelines, and user interfaces.

• Define communication interfaces and integration strategies across subsystems. • Architect IoT solutions for high performance, low latency, and efficient resource usage.

• Ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and quality requirements.

• Design and implement robust integration patterns between IoT devices and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, Google Cloud IoT Core), including device provisioning, authentication, and data ingestion.

• Assess emerging technologies (AI/ML, GenAI, data platforms) with a focus on improving embedded platform engineering and automation.

• Lead technical discussions and architecture / design reviews.

• Drive innovative initiatives and proof-of-concepts (POCs).

• Evaluate emerging tools, frameworks, and connectivity solutions.

• Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for embedded systems.

• Mentor development teams on architecture, best practices, and technical direction.

• Support teams in debugging complex system-level issues and root cause analysis.

Required Skills & Experience.

• Proven experience in designing and implementing end-to-end IoT architectures that span embedded devices, connectivity, and cloud layers.

• Hands-on experience with major cloud IoT platforms.

• Solid understanding of wireless connectivity technologies.

• Ability to analyze tradeoffs between performance, memory, power, and cost.

• Strong analytical thinking and system-level problem-solving capability.

• Good communication, technical mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Familiarity with automation frameworks and DevOps practices in embedded systems.

• Curiosity toward industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development

Must Have:

• Extensive experience designing and deploying complex IoT solutions at scale, integrating embedded devices with cloud platforms.

Good to Have:

ISAQB Certification, Professional certifications in Cloud Arch.

jobs.description:
With a proud history dating back 140 years, the Bosch Group now employs over 413,000 people across 60 countries incorporating 150 nationalities. As a leading IoT company, Bosch offers innovative solutions for smart homes, smart cities, connected mobility, and connected manufacturing. The Bosch Group’s strategic objective is to facilitate connected living and innovations for a connected life. Bosch improves quality of life worldwide with products and services that are innovative and spark enthusiasm. In short, Bosch creates technology that is “Invented for life.” To this day, Bosch remains privately owned, with 94% held by a charitable trust. Bosch is a rather special company. With its more than 470 locations worldwide, the Bosch Group has been carbon neutral overall (scopes 1 & 2 of the Greenhouse Gas Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard) since 2020. This is achieved with four levers: improving energy efficiency, generating energy from renewable sources, purchasing green electricity, and offsetting residual CO₂ emissions with carbon credits. Visit sustainability.bosch.com for further information on the Bosch Group’s sustainability strategy.

The Power Tools division is among the world market leaders for Power Tools, Accessories, Outdoor Power Equipment, Hand Tools and Storage for the Professional, DIY and Industrial sectors. With an amazing suite of brands including Bosch, Dremel, Diablo and sia Abrasives, the Power Tools division stands for innovation, safety and quality with a clear customer/user centricity. We develop, encourage and empower our associates to reach their full potential. Through our values-based culture we foster and engage a high performing organisation.

Bosch is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and encourage applicants of all backgrounds.

Bosch Power Tools is looking for a driven Solutions Specialist to grow our presence across the Greater Sydney market, working directly with B2C end users.

This is not a traditional account management role. We are looking for a high energy, hunter — someone who enjoys identifying new opportunities, opening doors, winning new customers and growing the Bosch brand through genuine customer engagement and consultative selling.

About the Role

This is a high-impact, field-based role (80% on the road) where you will work directly with end users across manufacturing, industrial, and commercial sectors.

You’ll combine technical expertise, relationship building, and consultative selling to convert customers to Bosch products and build long-term brand loyalty.

You will:

- Hunt and develop new business through self-generated leads, dealer referrals and targeted prospecting.

- Identify customer needs and convert opportunities through consultative, solutions-based selling.

- Build relationships directly with end users — from tradespeople and site managers through to procurement and C-suite stakeholders.

- Create demand for Bosch products through presentations, demonstrations, problem solving and technical recommendations.

- Conduct site visits, assessments and product demonstrations to identify opportunities and deliver practical solutions.

- Develop and execute structured visit plans to maximise customer coverage, productivity and sales outcomes.

- Introduce new products and solutions into targeted customer organisations and training organisations.

- Manage tender and project opportunities in collaboration with internal stakeholders.

- Maintain accurate customer, activity and opportunity information through Bosch CRM systems.

- Work closely with Sales and Marketing to provide market feedback and help shape the end-user strategy.
jobs.requirements_raw:
This role requires proven B2C / end-user sales experience and a demonstrated ability to win new business.

You should be able to demonstrate the following:

- Proven success in B2C, end-user or large-user sales.

- A strong track record in business development and new customer acquisition.

- Demonstrated hunting and prospecting capability — you actively create opportunities rather than waiting for them.

- Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation and influencing skills.

- The confidence to engage with stakeholders from site-based users through to senior executives.

- Excellent planning, organisation and time-management skills.

- Strong communication and relationship-building capability.

- High attention to detail and disciplined CRM management.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

- A highly self-driven, resilient and commercially focused approach.

- A strong work ethic, determination to succeed and the ability to work autonomously while contributing to a broader team.

- A valid Driver's Licence.

Industry Experience

- Experience in hardware, power tools, construction, building or trade environments will be highly regarded.

- A White Card and Working with Children Check are required, or you must be willing to obtain them.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity for a genuine new-business sales professional to take ownership of a territory and make a measurable impact on Bosch's growth.

You'll spend the majority of your time in the field — meeting customers, identifying opportunities, solving problems and converting new business — supported by the strength of a global technology and engineering organisation.

If you're commercially driven, confident in front of customers and motivated by finding the next opportunity and winning the business, this could be your next career move.

Join Bosch and help shape the future of professional power tools through customer-focused solutions, innovation and relationships.

At Bosch eBike, we are revolutionizing the cycling experience with award-winning eBike systems and innovative features. We are seeking a passionate and skilled Software Developer to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of automated test environments, validation frameworks, and engineering tools that ensure the quality and reliability of our cutting-edge eBike systems.

If you enjoy developing software solutions for embedded systems, designing automated test infrastructures, and solving complex technical challenges, this is your opportunity to contribute to a world-leading brand.

Your contribution to something big:

As a Software Developer (Python), you will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of automated test environments and validation frameworks for Linux-based embedded software projects. You will enable fully automated testing of embedded systems in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments and support the continuous improvement of software quality throughout the development lifecycle.

You will contribute to this goal by:

Test Environment Development & Automation

- Developing and maintaining Python-based test frameworks for Linux embedded software projects.

- Enabling fully automated testing of embedded software in Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) setups.

- Implementing automated execution of test cases, component resets, log collection, bug reporting, and consolidated test reporting.

- Developing automation solutions using Pytest and modern software engineering practices.

- Supporting continuous integration and continuous testing activities.

Software Design & Architecture

- Designing scalable, maintainable, and robust software architectures for test environments and engineering tools.

- Defining and implementing KPI measurements to monitor software quality, reliability, and testing efficiency.

- Creating reusable libraries, APIs, and services to support validation and testing activities across engineering teams.

- Contributing to the evolution of software architecture, coding standards, and development methodologies.

Embedded Systems Validation

- Supporting all software testing activities from requirements management through test specification, implementation, execution, reporting, and defect tracking.

- Analyzing CAN communication traces and system behavior to identify issues and improve product quality.

- Working closely with software, electronics, and system engineering teams to ensure complete validation coverage.

Tooling & Infrastructure

- Working with modern development and testing tools in a Linux environment.

- Utilizing Git, GitHub, Jira, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines to support efficient development and validation processes.

- Integrating and utilizing debugging and analysis tools such as Lauterbach and SEGGER interfaces.

- Supporting automation and infrastructure improvements for validation environments.

Documentation & Reporting

- Creating and maintaining technical documentation, including software architecture, test frameworks, operational procedures, and user guides.

- Producing clear, traceable test reports and ensuring transparency of testing results.

- Supporting knowledge sharing and continuous process improvement within the team.

Residential heat pumps can provide electrical flexibility by utilizing the thermal storage available in buildings, domestic hot water (DHW) tanks, and buffer storage systems.

This Master's thesis focuses on the automated estimation and forecasting of the flexibility potential of residential heat pump systems. Building on existing concepts and methods, you will investigate how thermal characteristics and storage capacities can be identified from monitoring data and used to quantify the flexibility that a heat pump system can provide.

- You will review existing approaches, analyze field monitoring data, and define suitable data processing workflows. Based on this data, you will identify key thermal parameters of buildings and storage systems and use them to estimate available flexibility over time.

- Furthermore, you will integrate the developed models into a flexibility forecasting workflow and evaluate their performance using real-world data. The analysis will cover both individual homes and aggregated fleets of heat pumps, including the impact of aggregation on flexibility estimation and forecasting accuracy.

- As part of the thesis, you will extend and validate an automated end-to-end workflow covering: Data preprocessing and quality assessment, Thermal system characterization, Estimation of thermal storage capacity, Flexibility estimation and forecasting, Analysis of individual systems and aggregated fleets.

- Finally, you will evaluate the developed approach.

Welcome to Bosch Motorsport, a premier supplier of electronics, sensors, actuators, and engineering services to top racing series and teams worldwide. Here at Bosch Motorsport North America, you'll be part of a growing, dynamic, and entrepreneurial team, taking on challenging tasks.

As a vital member of our engineering team, you will play a key role in supporting our application and development engineers in projects focused on professional motorsport within North America. Embrace this opportunity to make an impact in the exciting world of motorsport technology!

What You Will Do

The Associate Motorsport Software Engineer supports the worldwide development and application of connectivity products and services for motorsport applications. This position requires the ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments and involves frequent domestic and international travel (approximately 40–60 days per year).

- Connectivity and Telemetry Development

Participate in development of advanced connectivity and telemetry products and services at global development sites, customer locations, and race tracks.

- Trackside Diagnostics and System Configuration

Deploy trackside to set up and maintain trackside telemetry servers, manage wireless radio connections, and develop standardized data analysis dashboards for performance evaluation. Identify and resolve complex software, connectivity, and system-level issues under high-pressure conditions. Willingness to participate in an on call rotation to support race events.

- Customer Application Engineering

Collect customer requirements, manage project timelines, and deliver technical application support for motorsport products and services focusing on telemetry gateway units and Cloud services for data collection, analysis, and distribution.

- Requirements Management

Interface directly with customers to collect and clarify technical requirements to help manage project timelines, and ensure on-time delivery to meet project and customer milestones.

- HIL and Cloud System Testing

Validate customer-level, component-level, and system-level requirements through Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) bench tests and Cloud system tests. Interface directly with internal development teams to align feedback for development improvements.

- Workflow Optimization

Support the development and optimization of internal software tools and workflow scripts using MATLAB, Python, C#, or similar languages to improve application processes and team efficiency.

- Domestic and International Travel

Travel domestically and internationally (approximately 40–60 days per year) to provide elite technical support directly on-site at customer, track, and other development sites.

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

- 1+ years of experience in industry-relevant application engineering (academic or industry experience).

- 1+ years of experience working with industry-standard data acquisition and data analysis software.

- Experience in professional motorsport, significant collegiate racing (e.g., Formula SAE, EcoCAR), or equivalent high-performance environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- Automotive Communications and Networking

Knowledge of network communication frameworks, including the OSI and TCP/IP models.

Experience with wired and wireless networking technologies and protocols, such as TCP, UDP, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and cellular communications.

Familiarity with hardware configuration, communication software, embedded systems, Linux or Windows command-line environments, and automotive communication protocols such as CAN and Ethernet.

- Cloud Technologies and Data Streaming

Experience with Cloud-based services, containerized applications, and data-stream processing technologies, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, MQTT, and Grafana.

- Database Management and Querying

Experience writing queries using SQL or similar database query languages.

Experience with relational and non-relational database technologies used to manage engineering, testing, or simulation data, such as SQL Server, MongoDB, or InfluxDB.

- Programming and Scripting

Experience using programming or scripting languages, such as Python, MATLAB, or C#, for data analysis, automation, testing, or software development activities.

- Diagnostic and Engineering Tools

Experience using engineering, diagnostic, or test tools such as Wireshark, CANalyzer, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, or similar technologies.

- Electrical and System Analysis

Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.

Experience with system troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, software debugging, and vehicle-level diagnostics.

- Powertrain and Control Systems

Knowledge of or experience with internal combustion, hybrid, and/or battery-electric vehicle systems, including powertrain, chassis, or controls development.

Ideal Candidate Characteristics

- Motorsport Passion and Drive

Possesses a genuine passion for professional motorsport with a relentless drive to make meaningful technical contributions to internal teams and customers.

- Proactive Self-Starter

Thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment; demonstrates strong personal accountability and takes the initiative to solve problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

- Data-Driven Adaptability

Maintains high flexibility in fast-moving trackside environments, utilizing objective data and analytical logic to manage uncertainty and resolve system issues.

- Disciplined Independence and Teamwork

Collaborates seamlessly within a tight-knit, multi-disciplinary trackside team, while maintaining the self-discipline and time management necessary to execute individual tasks to meet deadlines.

- Growth Mindset and Curiosity

Willingness to learn and grow outside of immediate area of responsibility, constantly seeking ways to continuously improve both personal workflows and team processes.

- Clear and Objective Communication

Articulates technical concepts, test observations, and diagnostic issues clearly and objectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, through verbal communication and in written reports.

If you’re passionate about motorsport and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply. Join Bosch Motorsport in shaping the future of racing technology.

Our Motorsport Culture

Passion and Performance: At Bosch Motorsport North America, we are a close-knit team of dedicated professionals united by our unwavering passion for achieving peak performance, both on and off the track. Our shared commitment drives us to strive for nothing less than the top step of the podium in everything we undertake.

Entrepreneurial Mindset and Innovation: Embracing an entrepreneurial mindset, we constantly challenge the conventional norms. Fueled by innovation and a thirst for progress, we fearlessly tackle technical and commercial challenges to pave the way for groundbreaking solutions.

Communication: Building strong relationships internally and with our valued customers is paramount. Through open and transparent dialogue, we foster a culture of trust and collaboration, ensuring that we understand and meet the needs of everyone involved.

Balance: While we relentlessly pursue victory, we recognize the importance of balance. We believe in working hard but also cherish the value of a healthy work-life balance. This equilibrium empowers our team members to maintain their passion and drive while enjoying personal well-being and growth.

Together, we embrace a culture that pushes boundaries, fosters innovation, and cultivates genuine connections. Our collective determination and relentless pursuit of excellence propel us forward as a winning team, setting new standards in the world of motorsport.
